apiKeys.title: API Credentials
apiKeys.overview: This page manages the two sets of credentials used to integrate with this system: Open API keys serve system-to-system calls (/api/v2/open), while Magic Finance integration credentials are configured by Magic Finance under "Upstream" (/api/v2/zjmf). Both support IP allowlists, expiration dates, and call auditing.
apiKeys.linkageNote: The two credential sets are linked in one direction only: disabling the upstream connection under "Magic Finance Integration" also disables every Open API key on this account; the reverse does not hold, since disabling or deleting a single key has no effect on the Magic Finance integration.
apiKeys.empty: No API keys yet. Use the button in the top right to create one.
apiKeys.scopeHint: Read/write includes read-only. See the Open API documentation for the endpoints covered by each scope.
apiKeys.ipLabel: IP allowlist (optional, separate multiple entries with commas)
apiKeys.secretWarning: The full key is shown only once and cannot be viewed again. Save it somewhere safe, and use Edit to update the expiry or allowlist later.
apiKeys.deleteBody: Delete the key "{name}"? Any integration using it stops working immediately. The ZJMF finance credential is not affected.
apiKeys.disableBody: Disabling "{name}" stops any integration using it until it is enabled again. The ZJMF finance credential is not affected.
